agent.note: Pinned model; official SAB run_infer.py supports OpenAI/Bedrock only. DeepSeek is used via OpenAI-compatible chat completions. Model identity is recorded in every trace.

A.description: Task instruction + dataset info only. No strategy block.

B.description: Same as A plus a preregistered generic research strategy block.

fixed_strategy.preconditions: The task asks for a data-driven scientific analysis with a specific output file.
fixed_strategy.research_action: Before writing the full analysis, first write a minimal baseline that only loads the data and saves a trivial but correctly formatted output at the required path. Then iterate: add one analysis step at a time and re-run to verify each step produces a valid intermediate result before adding the next. Prefer the cheapest discriminating check over a complex pipeline.
fixed_strategy.expected_evidence: The program must save the output file at the exact requested path, and each iteration must be re-executed to confirm no runtime error before proceeding.
fixed_strategy.invalidity_conditions: If the dataset path is inaccessible or the required output format is ambiguous after inspecting previews, stop and report the blocker rather than inventing data.
fixed_strategy.source_provenance: Preregistered generic research tactic (baseline-before-escalation); no target-task outcome observed; no hidden evaluation key used.
fixed_strategy.cost_constraints: Stay within the run budget; do not add unnecessary dependencies.

selected_tasks.selection_rationale: Non-visual JSON output (saliva_pred.json); Feature Engineering; avoids GPT-4o visual judge dependency. BioPsyKit saliva feature extraction.
Non-visual text output (compound_filter_results.txt); Computational Analysis only; avoids visual judge. antibioticsai compound filter.
Non-visual CSV output (deforestation_rate.csv); Geospatial Analysis only; avoids visual judge. geopandas deforestation rate.

notes: One paired seed per domain is the minimum pilot. Not statistically powered. No multi-seed sweep is run this round. Strategy B is fixed before any target-task outcome is observed.
